notable_absence.finding: server/'s equivalent page gates the whole CBO feature behind Enterprise Edition ('a feature available in Couchbase Server Enterprise Edition'). This Capella page states 'The cost-based optimizer is enabled by default. You can enable or disable it as required' with no edition qualifier whatsoever - consistent with Capella having no editions. This is a clean instance of the edition-gate simply disappearing on Capella rather than being awkwardly ported, unlike the version-citation anomaly below.

cross_component_finding: Recurrence of the known issue docs-issues/capella-pages-cite-server-versions.json: this page states 'In Couchbase Server 7.6 and later, the Query service automatically gathers statistics whenever an index is created or built' and 'an opt-in feature called Auto Update Statistics (AUS) is available starting with Couchbase Server 8.0', despite Capella having no discrete version numbers.
cross_product_finding: Confirms the server/-vs-Capella edition/version split observed elsewhere: the EE-only gate from server/'s CBO page is dropped entirely here (no edition gate replaces it - Capella doesn't gate CBO by any credential type or role either), while the two server-version citations for statistics-gathering behavior are retained verbatim. So the edition gate and the version gate are handled inconsistently on the same page: one is correctly adapted for Capella (removed), the other is not (left as a literal server version).
